tools.description: Run ordinary persistent Python. np, Fraction, PIL, Image, shapely, cameras, buffers and scratch are available. blender(code,timeout=30) runs ordinary persistent Python in the current Blender. scene_data(selectors=None) reads current raw world geometry. render_views(names,include_images=False,fresh=False) obtains current shared frames. read_images(refs) attaches current images. Printed data are returned. Keep the scene read-only. Use public attributes and current task inputs. Private reflection, administrator/project files, product implementation APIs, external processes and network access are outside this experiment's source boundary. scratch supports ordinary file operations. observe(query=None,include_image=True) and task(query) execute the installed public API and return its original public JSON dictionary. PNGs from those calls are attached to this same tool reply. observe() defaults to the task target. task(query) takes the original mode=task query and requests no image. Multiple observe/task calls can run in one execute_python call. Use default brief responses. last_product_is_error records the most recent public MCP error flag. This installed version provides active_observation and the original separate mode=task query. Both public requests may be issued together in one execute_python call using observe(...) followed by task(...). Each function returns the original public JSON.
tools.name: execute_python

tools.description: Execute ordinary persistent Python in the current read-only Blender. bpy, mathutils and ordinary Python geometry operations are available. Return captured stdout, stderr and any error. Do not move, edit or save the scene.
tools.name: execute_blender_code

tools.description: Read current evaluated raw world vertices and source triangles in original object and triangle order, current source identity, and the six raw camera devices. selectors contains object names. Omit it to read all mesh objects. Source triangle indices are zero-based within each object's returned list.
tools.name: scene_data

tools.description: Read or generate current full-frame images with the shared low-level triangle renderer. A source/camera-bound cached frame is reused unless fresh is true. Frame refs are stable. buffers[ref] contains color, depth, owners and triangle_ids. Pixel origin is top-left, indices are zero-based, background owner and triangle ID are -1. Metadata object_names and source_face_offsets map frame owners and global triangle IDs to object names and local source faces. include_images delivers PNG content. This tool returns raw buffers and images.
tools.name: render_views

tools.description: Deliver PNG content for current-session frame refs. It reuses existing images and does not construct a new raster.
tools.name: read_images

tools.description: Current Blender facts. Directory query={mode:directory} with include_image=false returns tight evaluated world bounds, AABB centers and an independent directory binding. Task set example: {"include_image":false,"query":{"mode":"task","target":{"name":"A"},"candidates":[{"name":"B"}],"requested_facts":["closed_solid_relation","surface_proximity"]}}. Opt in to spatial_relation and surface_proximity for support-certified separation with closed-classification fallback. Unknown/duplicate rows remain. Complete penetration/nearest-separated sets require all relevant evidence; otherwise only known subsets are reported. Legacy objects pair/aabb supported. Global surface_nearest instead uses one query.objects selector without focal_id, or focal_id with query={"mode":"surface_nearest"}; session_id and include_image=false required. Complete means global nearest; partial means best-known. scene_revision/fingerprint bind this capture/source/revision; runtime_source_sha256 identifies code. Scene edits expire observations. Goals are caller criteria. For all current scene mesh pairs use query={"mode":"surface_scan","threshold_m":0.002}. This text-only scan includes hidden meshes, needs no selectors, includes threshold equality and reports coverage. Its unsigned triangle-surface distance describes surface proximity. Solid relations require separate facts. For surface_scan, omitted response_detail or brief returns a versioned compact table with readable names, object-table references, original distance_m and derived distance_mm. Explicit full returns detailed current evidence with witnesses. Combine observations using their scene/source binding. For finite active observation use {"query":{"mode":"active_observation"},"include_image":true}; add query.objects=[{"name":"Target"}] for one visual target with scene occluders. Returns brief source-bound region locations, owned-pixel anchors and remaining unknowns with up to six 512px native PNGs. Explicit response_detail=full includes diagnostics.

goal.description: Optional caller-supplied task criteria, evaluated separately from execution. Omitted object IDs bind to the selected observation/action pair. These criteria are not independently verified as the human user's intent.

include_image.description: False returns text evidence without rendering. surface_scan defaults to false and accepts only false. mesh_structure diagnose requires false and reads only the registered target raw mesh; patch may explicitly request images. Other observation modes retain default true.

query.description: Selectors use name OR id. Legacy exact_pairs/nearest/top1 use object_ids/max_exact_pairs. nearest needs complete exact nonpenetrating order; top1 may prune by strict outward bounds and reports ties. Unknown/budget-limited proofs do not certify nearest.

alignment_evidence.description: False omits optional face angles and requires include_image=false; strict distance, host rigid-frame and action checks remain.

candidates.description: 1..3 explicit candidates in request order; one capture with target. Requires surface_proximity with spatial_relation or closed_solid_relation. Optional aabb supplies bounds.

geometry.description: Opt-in geometry from the original relation bindings. Vertices use world metres; captured triangles are optional.

label_object_ids.description: Current full IDs for image annotation, separate from measurement object_ids: up to six related labels plus A/B. Missing pair/image, occlusion or undersampling is explicit; display only.

native_visual.description: Display policy only; never execution permission. Auto uses a negotiated read-only native host, otherwise the analytical projection. Projection skips negotiation; multiscale requires support. Labels and contact sections require projection.

objects.description: active_observation: one visual target. Legacy task: aabb 1..4 selectors; pair facts two ordered A to B.

operation.description: Registered target reads. mesh_structure: diagnose text or patch images. mesh_surface (local opt-in): diagnose/reference/restore_preview require include_image=false; reference_patch uses a returned opaque patch_ref and optional native images. References are locally trusted; previews do not execute; the original task budget applies.

requested_facts.description: task: spatial_relation proves strict full-referenced-vertex support separation or uses closed-shell classification, with geometry_scope identifying the performed proof. closed_solid_relation is zero-tolerance separated/touching/penetrating (positive-volume overlap, including containment) for represented connected closed triangle shells; invalid/ambiguous is unknown. surface_proximity independently gives nonnegative triangle-surface distance, original world witness points and positive-distance A-to-B direction; zero-distance direction is inapplicable. Boundary/nonmanifold counts do not certify solids. Penetrating/contained distances are not separated gaps. pair_relation's escape of A is not surface distance, nearest direction or minimum depth.

support_plane_discovery.description: Read-only discovery of bounded original support-plane selectors for the current focal/reference pair. Omit direction for geometry only; no action direction is invented.

task_ref.description: Trusted begin handoff, required in local lifecycle mode; selects the active generation without creating or renewing a task.

visual_diagnostic.description: Analytical full-mesh contact section beside natural views; not visibility evidence or action permission.

response_detail.description: Optional display projection. surface_scan defaults to brief: a versioned table preserves all delivered matches, raw metre distances, derived millimetres, identities, scopes and unknowns. distance_mm uses a number, or an exact decimal string when binary64 millimetres overflow. Its object table covers matched endpoints. Full requests a new current observation with detailed witnesses; combine observations by scene/source binding. active_observation also defaults to brief, with all objects, region unknowns, actual pixel facts and native image references; full retains diagnostics. Other modes default to full; their brief omits named camera/raster diagnostics while preserving measurements and native images. Errors and unsupported projections retain the detailed response.

scene_delta.description: Optional observation-only snapshot transport. Empty object asks for full resync; a complete base revision and SHA256 enables a delta when worthwhile.

tools.name: human_eye_scene_observe
